cv.name: Hamish Lowe
cv.headline: Marketing Manager – Retail & Outdoor | Omnichannel campaigns
cv.summary: Marketing manager with seven years in specialty retail and events. Leads a small team across brand, CRM and paid media for an outdoor retailer with stores and a growing online business.

experience.title: Marketing Manager
bullets: Lead a team of four covering brand, CRM, social and in-store marketing for 14 stores and online
Own the A$2.3M annual marketing budget and the seasonal campaign calendar
Relaunched the loyalty program; active members grew from 41k to 96k in 18 months
Work with buying and visual merchandising on range launches and catalogue

experience.title: Senior Marketing Executive
bullets: Managed paid search and social for the e-commerce site; online revenue share rose from 12% to 30%
Ran partnerships with cycling clubs and community events

experience.title: Marketing Coordinator
bullets: Promoted festivals and markets through social, EDMs and local media
